brief.t: First: clear the live freight and shipment lane. WhatsApp shows BuffMan with 15 unread messages and a freight-forwarder message at 6:01 AM; a CH Robinson freight invoice also arrived this morning. Verify the load, owner, and payment/hold status before promising any pickup or delivery.

Second: contain payable risk. bitop AG sent a dunning notice this morning, and the CH Robinson load invoice is new. Confirm amounts, due dates, and whether either item can stop materials, freight, or production; do not pay from an email alone.

Third: give Natugeda a verified production update. Hair Oil remains listed as Production Scheduled in the last CRM capture, while the customer requested status and a timeline. Operations must confirm the actual stage and next date before a customer response.

Fourth: close Ashley / Earth and Ash packaging and labels. Ashley supplied all three Miron bottle/closure codes, says she is ready to pay on invoice, and asked yesterday for the paper-label sample-to-print path. Invoice sent, payment, artwork approval, printer lead time, and specialty-bottle quote status all require confirmation.

Treat Chris’s sporting balm inquiry as a regulatory qualification, not a production promise. Chris confirmed the existing Australian recipes have heating and cooling effects; Sam’s reply correctly flagged potential U.S. OTC-drug implications. No cosmetic-manufacturing commitment without regulatory review.

Aleta hair line is a fresh qualified lead: Constance identified a type-4C detangler as her starting hero product. Qualify formula brief, target units, packaging, launch timing, and budget before quoting.
CRM live access is logged out, so task count, overdue count, pipeline figures, and the Assign To defect are carried forward only from the last authenticated capture. Do not mark CRM issues resolved.

Get operations facts for Natugeda, then issue a verified production update
Close Ashley invoice, payment, packaging, and paper-label workflow; then qualify Aleta

kb.a: WhatsApp Web showed BuffMan PLL with 15 unread messages and a 6:01 AM July 29 preview referring to freight. The full conversation was not successfully extracted in this refresh, so the shipment, request, and deadline remain unverified. Treat it as the first operational check, not as a confirmed delivery commitment.

CH Robinson issued invoice 6247783636 for load 555812351 on July 29. The message provides an online payment link but no validated due date, amount, or link to a specific customer shipment in the evidence reviewed. Verify against internal records before payment or customer communication.

bitop AG sent a dunning notice on July 29 requesting payment of an outstanding amount to avoid further fees. The amount, original invoice, and any material/production hold were not verified in this refresh. Finance should match it to the ledger and confirm urgency.

Natugeda requested production status and an estimated timeline on July 27. The last authenticated CRM capture lists Hair Oil for Natugeda as Production Scheduled. No current production stage or delivery date was verified July 29, so operations must confirm before responding.

Ashley provided Miron component codes for Radiance Face Oil, Solar Body Oil, and Natural Lip Gloss, is ready to pay once invoiced, and asked July 28 for paper-label sample-to-print workflow and timing. Laura said July 24 that she would send the invoice; sent/payment status, artwork approval, printer lead time, and specialty-bottle quote status are unverified.

Chris confirmed his Australian sporting balm recipes use heating and cooling effects. Sam advised that U.S. heating, cooling, or muscle-recovery claims and active ingredients can trigger OTC-drug requirements. Do not quote or promise cosmetic manufacture without regulatory classification and scope review.

Constance replied July 29 that aleta wants a type-4C detangler as its first hero product, intended to give extra slip for thick and thin hair. Product requirements, units, packaging, launch timing, and budget have not been qualified; no MOQ or price has been promised.

Victor’s task remains due July 31. The authoritative day update says PLL reached him and he will confirm packaging compatibility with the Edge Control formula; full cost inputs and final quote are still unverified.

The last confirmed Terra Lotus direction is that Kenna needs cleanser and oil-cleanser support. No current meeting time or price/quote status was verified in this refresh; do not present a meeting or quote as confirmed.

Live CRM task pages presented a sign-in screen on July 29. The last authenticated capture showed 11 tasks, 8 overdue, 9 active deals, $1,327,800 pipeline, 20 projects in production, and $57,454.99 deposits; those figures are not live-verified. The customer-page Assign To dropdown issue was still reported in team chat July 28.
